LESSON: GROUP READING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING 3.1 Paired reading By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners read alo
Topic 3.2: Group Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Group Reading. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what, where?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. develop peer learning skills of self-assessment
2. improve confidence through peer support in group reading
3. develop an interest in reading collectively in and out of class

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. develop peer learning skills of self-assessment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop peer learning skills of self-assessment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. improve confidence through peer support in group reading
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to improve confidence through peer support in group reading. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. develop an interest in reading collectively in and out of class
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop an interest in reading collectively in and out of class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Group Reading.
2. Explain Group Reading to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Group Reading.
4. Show that you can: develop peer learning skills of self-assessment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Group Reading. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what, where?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. develop peer learning skills of self-assessment
2. improve confidence through peer support in group reading
3. develop an interest in reading collectively in and out of class

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
